purpose: Editorial provenance for the MedGraph project page; no new experiments were run.

sources.supports: Binning, marker selection, missingness, domain consultation, and intended screening task.
Referral-clue removal, masking post-scan CMR, marker categories, missingness filtering.

distmult.png.description: Unmodified report figure; primary image. Cluster separation does not establish better predictive performance.
distmult.png.presentation: Responsive PCA, UMAP, and side-by-side views of the unchanged source bitmap. No coordinates were available for replotting; no points or axes were edited.

bipartite.png.description: Unmodified report figure; patient to encoded marker-value subgraph. Exploratory label edges are distinguished from GNN inputs.

limits: Report claims were used for methodology. Performance numbers and superiority claims are omitted. Future disease prediction, clinical validity, and leakage-free embedding-to-GNN evaluation are not established.
